review: Code-blind inspection of sixteen fixed-camera live/restored current frames across four stands and two sampled times
confirmed_findings: P2-066: live currents have rigid long parallel white streaks
P2-067: surrounding shore and water color show little change between states
visible_state_change: The live streaks vanish in the restored frames at each stand.
limits: t0 and t1 are too similar in stills to judge animation timing. Four fixed views may omit changes elsewhere on the route.
